answer: The voyage for a single honest agent is a short check; for a farm it is a one-per-person interview slot that books out months ahead, so scale means waiting, not just paying repeated on every name. Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the ripple per clone stays flat while the bill climbs, and the horizon is the point where cloning stops paying. Make the first reward the most expensive one to reach. Authorised pilot licence with pilots association confirmation does that, because a licence the association renews after flight audits.
